v1.0.1-preview.24
- Renamed the shipped JavaScript module to fireForNet-auth-shared.js. The module now carries an explicit flavour marker, so the same name always means the same bytes.
- The module ships from a physical copy in this package's own wwwroot, instead of a link into the Blazor package. A linked copy resolved its content root to the linking project and 404ed at runtime.
